arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Halligan argued the Twenty-First Amendment does not propose a nondiscriminatory ban.
Mr. Casey argued states may restrict importation by out-of-state vendors.
Mr. Bolick argued states may regulate alcohol by one set of rules.
Ms. Sullivan argued the case does not require taking on the three-tier system.
